function.name: apply_ontology_yaml
function.description: Apply new or changed classes, relationships, rules, or actions to the live ontology the expert is looking at. Only include entries that are new or have changed — this merges against the existing model, it does not need to restate everything. At most one call to this tool is processed per message.

yaml.description: Domain-model YAML using the classes/relationships/rules/actions block-style shape.

function.name: get_graph_state
function.description: Returns the ontology's current live state (classes, relationships, rules, actions) exactly as it is on the canvas right now, in the same YAML shape apply_ontology_yaml accepts. Takes no arguments. Call this whenever you're not certain your own memory of what's already defined is still accurate — the expert can edit the canvas directly at any time, independent of this conversation.
